environment: Chromium 156 / desktop GTX 1080 Ti, 1600x1000 DPR1, eight-second main-thread captures
method: CDP allocation sampling at 16384 bytes, including objects collected by minor/major GC; devtools.timeline GC events. Fixed-LOD runs verified identical 72 tiles and 3,196,522 triangles. Baseline source snapshot served separately against the same local data.
changes: Bounded versioned finest-tile footprint cache, including absent columns; no column result tuples.
Reusable label priority/rectangle/vector buffers; skip unchanged transform strings.
Stable priority heap replaces repeated candidate sort; compact leaf arrays in place.
Dense active LOD lookup for labels/lights; reusable selection and eviction sets/buffers.
Reusable shadow fitting and navigation math objects.
limitations: Sampling estimates are not exact allocated bytes or retained heap. Worker allocations are excluded.
Profiler/tracing adds overhead; frame times are not uninstrumented product benchmarks.

Adaptive runs can differ in streaming/admission timing. Final paired runs matched start/end tile and triangle counts. Frame timings varied between capture sessions, and the initial Civic sample regressed; no general FPS improvement is claimed.
Remaining allocations include Three.js uniforms/render lists, N8AO, moving label CSS strings and streaming result ownership.
The local dataset contains separately uncommitted vegetation changes, unchanged between captures.
validation: npm run build; node tools/test-voxel.mjs; node tools/test-sun.mjs
node tools/test-frame-allocations.mjs: 24 exact selector comparisons, 240 exact label frames, 120 exact navigation frames
node tools/check-voxel.mjs ../artifacts/profiling/gc-voxel-validation.json: pixel equality, streaming/retry/cancellation/coverage/eviction/context restore passed
LOD=0 node tools/check-shadows.mjs ../artifacts/profiling/gc-shadow-check.json: eight scenarios passed
node tools/check-gc-ui.mjs: 5712 tile-gating comparisons, night and F3/F4 toggles passed without GL/page errors
reproduce: Serve baseline cf1c7e1 and this branch separately with identical public data. Run tools/profile-gc.mjs with URL set to each server. For fixed captures also set LOD=4 and VIEWS=civic. Default viewport 1600x1000 DPR1, 8 seconds per stationary/moving sample. Avoid concurrent browser benchmarks.
